What drives me

I’m someone who believes in learning by doing, taking initiative, and turning ideas into meaningful experiences. As a Computer Science and Engineering student specialising in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, I’m driven by curiosity, a passion for problem-solving, and the excitement of exploring what’s possible.

Beyond academics, I enjoy stepping up, bringing people together, and turning plans into action. My experience in student leadership, event coordination, and organising technical initiatives has taught me the value of teamwork, adaptability, clear communication, and taking ownership of every responsibility I undertake.

I’m always eager to step beyond my comfort zone, embrace new challenges, and learn from the people and experiences around me. I’m looking forward to opportunities where I can contribute with enthusiasm, grow through real-world experiences, and make a meaningful impact wherever I go.

Technical skills

Projects

Every project here started as a simple idea and grew into something I'm truly proud of! Along the way I learned, got stuck, tried again and finally made it work, and I can't wait to build even more. 🚀

Hospital Management System

A web app that brings patients, doctors, billing and staff into one system, with secure login, doctor assignment and an admin dashboard so staff can manage records without touching the database.

PHPMySQLJavaScriptHTML/CSS

Course Review Classification & Recommendation Engine

A pipeline that reads 120,000+ student reviews, classifies the course each one is about and recommends the 10 most similar reviews. Sentence-Transformer embeddings catch reviews that mean the same thing in different words.

PythonTF-IDFSVMSentence-Transformers

Fake News Detection

A fake news detector built from scratch. Article text is cleaned, tokenised and vectorised, then models are tuned using F1-score and the confusion matrix to reduce false positives.

PythonTF-IDFLogistic RegressionNaive Bayes

Scholarship Eligibility Prediction

Compared Logistic Regression and Decision Tree models on academic and socio-economic data to automate eligibility decisions, validated with accuracy, precision and recall.

Pythonscikit-learnData cleaning
